entries.note: Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code order_placed.
Seen live as READY_FOR_DISPATCH, the booking handed to dispatch; the row's location is the sender's address.
The booking recorded. The tracker labels it Shipment Confirmed for courier bookings and Order Confirmed otherwise.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code pickup_scheduled.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code not_picked_up. The courier did not collect the parcel.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code pickup_completed.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code in_transit. The script shows the same label for hub scans, bagging and dispatch codes.
Received at a hub; the row names the hub.
Sent from a hub to a delivery branch.
Departed from a hub.
Received at the delivery branch; the row's location is sometimes the placeholder default.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code ready_for_delivery. At the delivery branch.
Seen live from the delivery branch's run sheet.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code undelivered.
Label Shree Maruti's tracker script (tracking.shreemaruti.com) shows for the event code carry_forward_to_next_day. Not delivered today and carried forward to the next day.
Seen live, from the courier's app and again in copies imported later.
